text: Filed #6573 (open, owner-authored, agent-approved): native VFP9 imports CSV -1.235 into N(5,2) and stores -1.24; Copperfin rejects the six-character input against width 5 before rounding, then rolls back. Distinct from #6572: this value is in range after scale rounding, so the safety-policy question there does not apply. Evidence under /home/rich/temp/copperfin-csv-round-probe.
